name: Rigoberta Menchú
shortBio: K'iche' Maya human rights philosopher, Nobel Peace Laureate, and testimonial theorist whose I, Rigoberta Menchú catalyzed global debates on collective Indigenous testimony (testimonio), memory, and state violence.
centralQuestion: How does collective Indigenous testimonio challenge Western individualized historiography and articulate communal moral claims to life and land?

keyWorks.title: I, Rigoberta Menchú: An Indian Woman in Guatemala
keyWorks.description: Canonical testimonial work chronicling K'iche' Maya communal cosmology, agrarian struggle, and resistance to state terror.
